title: Holding-Ceiling Excess on a Class H Preferred Stock Holding — Member Equities & Patronage Equity Accounting Rule
content:
The holding-ceiling excess of a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding is the shares counted toward the ceiling less the holding ceiling, never below zero, to the cent.

## Rule

1. **Holding-ceiling excess**: the shares counted toward the ceiling less the holding ceiling, never below zero, to the cent.
2. **Shares counted toward the ceiling**: the holding's purchases plus its reinvested dividends less its retirements.
3. **Holding ceiling**: the class's largest balance a member may hold (USD 1000000 for Class H Preferred Stock in the class schedule of stock requirement and purchase terms).

## Worked figures (hypothetical holdings)

| Purchases | Reinvested dividends | Retirements | Shares counted | Excess over 1,000,000.00 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1,020,000.00 | 12,500.00 | 0.00 | 1,032,500.00 | 32,500.00 |
| 990,000.00 | 14,250.50 | 3,000.00 | 1,001,250.50 | 1,250.50 |
| 980,000.00 | 15,000.00 | 0.00 | 995,000.00 | 0.00 — below the ceiling |
| 1,000,000.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 1,000,000.00 | 0.00 — exactly at the ceiling |
